exposure: Previous CS because of non-progressive labor
previous CS because of non-progressive labour
outcome: Probability of successful vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC)
cohort: 586 women intending VBAC in 12 Dutch hospitals
finding: The prediction model for VBAC, including six predictors, showed good performance and was externally validated in a Dutch population.
mod_finding: A prediction model for successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) showed good performance in a Dutch population, suggesting it can be used to counsel women choosing between VBAC or planned cesarean section.
